title: Sarbacher put cameras on modified V2 rockets to chase UFOs

tellings.quote: Sarbacher's son has now gone on record saying, "My father told me that he used to put cameras on, you know, modified versions of V2 rockets in order to chase UFOs."
he would put uh cameras on these sort of modified V2s and they would try to take photos of UFOs
tellings.difference: Credits Townsend Brown and does not cite Sarbacher's son as the source.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Sarbacher put cameras on modified V2 rockets to photograph or chase UFOs.

as_told.title: Sarbacher's cameras on modified V2s to photograph UFOs

plain: The story is that after the war, scientists put cameras on modified V2s, the rockets Germany built in the Second World War, and sent them up to chase and photograph UFOs. Michels tells it twice. Once he says the son of a scientist named Robert Sarbacher has gone on record that his father told him he did this himself. The other time he credits the work to an American inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown and does not mention the son.
